I added a 0.25-second pause after each sandbox call in `tests/test_payments.py`. A limit of 5 requests per second means calls need to be at least 0.2s apart, so 0.25s leaves some room. The value is stored in a constant, `SANDBOX_CALL_INTERVAL_S`, so it's easy to change. The test now takes about 1 second longer.

I haven't run the test, since it's an integration test that calls the live sandbox. I also saved the rate limit in EngramDB as a project note, so any future tests that use the sandbox will know to slow down their calls.
